user_requirements:
系统名称: ChassisDomainController
系统描述: 集成ABS、EPS、ESP功能
组件数量: 6
组件类型: ABSController, EPSController, ESPController, WheelSpeedProcessor, CANGateway, SafetyMonitor
关键需求:
  - ABSController防抱死制动
  - EPSController电动助力转向
  - ESPController车身稳定控制
  - WheelSpeedProcessor处理4个轮速传感器数据
  - SafetyMonitor实现ASIL-D安全监控
  - 多条CAN总线互联

system_analysis.functional_decomposition: 将系统划分为6个SWC：WheelSpeedProcessor负责采集和滤波四路车轮速度信号并发布标准化速度数据；CANGateway负责不同CAN总线间消息路由与打包/解包；ABSController基于车轮速度与制动踏板输入执行防抱死控制并下发制动执行命令；EPSController基于驾驶扭矩与车辆速度计算助力并下发转向电机扭矩请求；ESPController融合ABS/EPS/车速/方向输入进行车身稳定控制并下发协调制动/转向干预请求；SafetyMonitor作为ASIL-D监控器执行一致性检查、故障隔离、降级请求与安全事件上报。各组件职责边界按数据所有权与功能聚合划分，避免跨组件直接控制硬件。组件间通过清晰的接口（S/R和C/S）交换数据与命令。
system_analysis.data_flow_analysis: 关键数据类型和流向：WheelSpeed (uint16[4], timestamp) 从 WheelSpeedProcessor 发布 (S/R WheelSpeed_IF) 到 ABSController, ESPController, SafetyMonitor，周期10ms；BrakeRequest (float, pressure_pct, timestamp) 从 ABSController 发布到 CANGateway/制动执行域，触发即时发送，控制延迟要求 <20ms；SteeringTorqueRequest (float, Nm) 从 EPSController 发布到 CANGateway/转向执行域，周期20ms，延迟 <30ms；ESP_Command (coordination flags, float intervention) 从 ESPController 到 ABSController/EPSController，用于协调控制，事件/异步；CAN_Message_IF 用于组件与CANGateway之间的原始CAN帧传输，按消息ID映射，支持多个总线通道；Health_Status (enum, fault_code, timestamp) 从 SafetyMonitor 发布到所有控制器与诊断收集器，可靠传输优先。通信模式明确：传感器数据采用最新值发布 (overwrite)；控制命令采用队列/可靠发送以保证顺序；诊断与安全事件采用重复发送与确认机制。
system_analysis.timing_requirements: WheelSpeedProcessor: 10ms 周期处理并发布；ABSController: 5ms 控制周期（实时性最高），控制闭环端到端延时 <20ms；EPSController: 20ms 周期，软实时，端到端延时 <30ms；ESPController: 5-10ms 响应外部触发（wheel slip 或转向快速变化）；CANGateway: 转发延时 <5ms/帧，高优先级消息排队优先；SafetyMonitor: 10ms 周期检查并在检测到ASIL-D违例时在<50ms内触发降级/告警。所有关键路径定义最大允许抖动与最大执行时间以供后续WCET评估。
system_analysis.scalability_considerations: 设计采用模块化接口与发布/订阅模式，便于添加更多控制器或传感器；CANGateway 使用可扩展的路由表与多总线抽象，支持横向扩展到更多CAN/FlexRay/CAN-FD通道；Runnables和端口按功能划分，支持在更多ECU或分布式部署；对于更大系统建议引入消息分级(QoS)与消息过滤策略以控制总线占用。

component_plan.name: WheelSpeedProcessor
component_plan.purpose: 采集4路车轮速度CAN消息，滤波、去噪、估算轮速与滑移并发布标准化WheelSpeed数据

port_estimates.input_ports: 4 CAN Rx inputs (wheel speed messages) + diag/config input
port_estimates.output_ports: 1 S/R port publishing aggregatedWheelSpeed + health output

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性10ms执行：接收CAN帧→解码→时间同步→低通滤波与滑移计算→有效性/故障检测→发布WheelSpeed。支持数据失步检测与异常标记。对丢帧进行插值或标记故障并通知SafetyMonitor。处理流程为：CAN_RX→Parse→Filter→Compute→Publish。

ports.details: R-PORT 接收原始CAN wheel speed frames；P-PORT 提供处理后WheelSpeed S/R数据发布；另有诊断P-PORT输出Health_Status

读取原始解析后的轮速变量用于滤波和计算

preselect.notes: 发布聚合后的WheelSpeed到S/R端口

component_plan.name: CANGateway
component_plan.purpose: 在多条CAN总线间路由、过滤与映射消息，执行打包/解包与优先级处理

port_estimates.input_ports: 多个CAN bus Rx ports (per bus), diagnostic client
port_estimates.output_ports: 多个CAN bus Tx ports (per bus), service C/S operations

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 事件驱动：收到CAN帧立即根据路由表进行转发或转换，支持同步C/S操作用于发送带确认的控制帧。对高优先级消息实行优先队列。提供接口用于路由表配置和诊断统计。数据流程：CAN_Rx→Route/Translate→CAN_Tx或上报至订阅者。

component_plan.name: ABSController
component_plan.purpose: 基于各轮速与踏板输入执行防抱死制动控制，计算并下发精确制动力命令

port_estimates.input_ports: WheelSpeed S/R input, brake pedal position, vehicle speed, safety status

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性5ms或事件触发执行：接收聚合轮速→轮值估计与滑移率计算→基于ABS算法（调节逻辑+PID/模糊控制）计算制动请求→发出BrakeRequest并请求CANGateway发送至执行器。具有状态机管理(Idle, Active, Fault, Degraded)。在故障或SafetyMonitor降级信号时进入降级策略。

ports.details: R-PORT 接收WheelSpeed与Safety状态；P-PORT 提供BrakeCommand与诊断输出；需C/S调用CANGateway发送帧

发布计算出的BrakeRequest
通过CANGateway异步请求发送执行器帧

elements.notes: 调用网关服务发送CAN命令

runnables.notes: ABS控制活动（算法执行、命令发送）

component_plan.name: EPSController
component_plan.purpose: 基于驾驶扭矩与车速计算电动助力转向请求并下发转向电机扭矩控制

port_estimates.input_ports: Steering torque sensor input, vehicle speed, safety status

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性20ms执行并支持事件触发：读取驾驶扭矩与车速，执行助力增益映射与安全限制，生成扭矩请求并通过CANGateway下发。包含状态机(Active, Assist_Limited, Fault)，在SafetyMonitor发出降级时调整助力策略。

ports.details: R-PORT 接收传感器与Safety状态；P-PORT 提供转向扭矩请求发布；支持网关调用

events.name: SteeringTorque_Updated
events.trigger: 新的扭矩传感器数据到达

preselect.notes: 读取驾驶扭矩与车速用于助力计算

elements.notes: 接收数值型传感器输入

preselect.notes: 发布SteeringTorqueRequest

component_plan.name: ESPController
component_plan.purpose: 融合传感器与控制器数据执行车身稳定策略，协调对ABS/EPS的干预请求

port_estimates.input_ports: WheelSpeed, SteeringAngle, YawRate, LateralAccel, Safety status
port_estimates.output_ports: ESP_Command S/R output to ABSController/EPSController and CANGateway

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 事件驱动与周期混合：在检测到滑移或动力学不稳时立即触发控制（事件驱动），同时周期性10ms运行以评估车辆状态。算法包括车辆动力学估计、干预决策与优先级仲裁。生成协调命令并通过S/R或C/S发送给ABS/EPS。状态管理包括 Normal、Intervene、Quiet、Fault。

ports.details: R-PORT 用于接收各类传感器与控制器数据；P-PORT 输出协调命令ESP_Command

runnables.name: Stability_Runnable

preselect.notes: 读取轮速、转向、横向加速度数据用于稳定性评估

elements.notes: 接收传感器与控制器输入

preselect.notes: 发布ESP协调命令到ABS/EPS

runnables.notes: 稳定性判断与干预请求

component_plan.name: SafetyMonitor
component_plan.purpose: 实现ASIL-D等级的安全监控与故障管理，执行跨组件一致性检查和降级控制请求

port_estimates.input_ports: 订阅WheelSpeed, ABS/EPS/ESP状态, CAN gateway诊断信息
port_estimates.output_ports: Safety status/command发布、诊断上报、降级命令

component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性10ms和事件驱动双模：周期检查关键健康指标、时序一致性与心跳；在检测到不一致或硬件故障时执行隔离策略并向相关组件发布降级/停止命令，同时记录并上报诊断事件。维护安全状态机（Safe, Degraded, Fault）并执行对应策略。

ports.details: R-PORT 订阅其他控制器的状态与关键数据；P-PORT 发布Health_Status与降级命令；需调用CANGateway发送诊断

runnables.name: Monitor_Runnable

preselect.notes: 读取ABS/EPS/ESP与WheelSpeed的状态与时间戳
同步调用网关或诊断服务以获取确认或发送安全命令

elements.notes: 调用诊断/发送安全指令

runnables.notes: 执行一致性检查、降级决策与事件上报

interface_plan.name: WheelSpeed_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R, latest-value overwrite for sensor streams, publish period 10ms, subscribers: ABSController, ESPController, SafetyMonitor. Loss handling: mark invalid and notify SafetyMonitor. Latency requirement <10ms from publisher to subscriber.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 10ms update rate, jitter <2ms, message priority high
interface_plan.direct_paths: WheelSpeedProcessor -> subscribers via CANGateway when跨总线; direct S/R within same ECU

interface_plan.name: BrakeCommand_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R with queued transmission for commands; command update on ABS every control cycle (5ms); reliability ensured via sequence/ack on CAN where available; buffer strategy: small FIFO for commands to preserve ordering
interface_plan.performance_requirements: end-to-end latency <20ms, ordering preserved, delivery confirmation preferred

interface_plan.name: SteeringTorque_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R, periodic 20ms with overwrite of latest value; best-effort for non-critical assist changes, reliable for stall/limit signals; buffering: latest-value

interface_plan.name: CAN_Message_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: 原始CAN帧的S/R接口，用于CANGateway与组件间帧交换；异步事件驱动，按消息ID优先级转发；缓冲策略为按优先级多队列，错误处理为重发与错误计数上报
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 帧转发延时 <5ms, 支持多总线映射与ID转换

interface_plan.name: Control_Service_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: C/S 接口用于同步配置与请求发送服务（例如CANGateway的SendWithAck）；同步/异步支持，超时与重试策略明确，超时一般 <100ms
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 控制服务高可靠，超时与错误返回必报，支持同期调用与结果点

interface_plan.name: HealthMonitor_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R 用于发布健康与安全状态，周期或事件触发（周期10ms），缓冲为重复上报直到确认接收策略，关键告警采用高优先级通道
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 紧急告警在50ms内传播，可靠送达机制与多次重发
interface_plan.direct_paths: SafetyMonitor -> 所有控制器及诊断收集端

connection_topology.component_connections: WheelSpeedProcessor publishes WheelSpeed_IF consumed by ABSController, ESPController, SafetyMonitor. ABSController and EPSController publish actuator commands (BrakeCommand_IF, SteeringTorque_IF) which are routed through CANGateway to actuator ECUs. CANGateway connects to multiple CAN buses and provides Control_Service_IF to other controllers for synchronous send/route config. SafetyMonitor subscribes to WheelSpeed_IF, Health inputs and can invoke Control_Service_IF on CANGateway to send safety commands.
connection_topology.data_flow_paths: Sensor -> WheelSpeedProcessor (CAN_Message_IF) -> WheelSpeed_IF -> ABS/EPS/ESP/SafetyMonitor. ABSController -> BrakeCommand_IF -> CANGateway -> BrakeActuator. EPSController -> SteeringTorque_IF -> CANGateway -> SteeringActuator. ESPController -> ESP_Command (S/R) -> ABSController/EPSController. SafetyMonitor -> HealthMonitor_IF -> all controllers.
connection_topology.control_flow_paths: CANGateway provides synchronous service endpoints (Control_Service_IF) used by ABS/EPS/SafetyMonitor for confirmed sends; ABS/EPS control loops run locally at 5ms/20ms respectively; ESPController may trigger immediate interventions to ABS/EPS via S/R or event notifications; SafetyMonitor can issue global degrade/stop commands via Control_Service_IF.

architecture_rationale.design_decisions: 采用发布/订阅(S/R)分离传感器数据与控制命令，CANGateway作为消息汇聚与跨总线路由实体，减少跨组件直接依赖，便于总线管理与安全审计。关键控制器为应用SWC，各自包含实时runnable以满足不同周期需求。SafetyMonitor作为独立ASIL-D实体以保证安全隔离与独立检测能力。
architecture_rationale.tradeoff_analysis: 集中式路由(CANGateway)简化网络管理和消息映射但增加单点转发延迟；分布式直接通信可降低延时但降低可控性与安全审计能力。选择S/R用于高频传感器数据以保持低耦合，选择C/S用于需要确认的发送或配置操作以确保可靠性。为满足性能与安全，部分高频控制保留本地周期runnable。
architecture_rationale.alternative_considerations: 可选将WheelSpeedProcessor分布到多个ECU以靠近传感器减少总线负载；或者将CANGateway功能拆分到多个网关ECU以降低单点故障风险；在更高性能需求下引入时间触发通信或CAN-FD。
architecture_rationale.risk_assessment: 主要风险包括总线拥塞与优先级反转、CANGateway单点故障、SafetyMonitor误报或延迟响应。缓解措施：关键消息设置高优先级与带宽保障；CANGateway实现冗余路径或降级策略；SafetyMonitor 使用独立时钟与硬件隔离并加固超时/重试策略。

interface_plan.name: WheelSpeed_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R, latest-value overwrite for sensor streams, publish period 10ms, subscribers: ABSController, ESPController, SafetyMonitor. Loss handling: mark invalid and notify SafetyMonitor. Latency requirement <10ms from publisher to subscriber.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 10ms update rate, jitter <2ms, message priority high
interface_plan.direct_paths: WheelSpeedProcessor -> subscribers via CANGateway when跨总线; direct S/R within same ECU

interface_plan.name: BrakeCommand_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R with queued transmission for commands; command update on ABS every control cycle (5ms); reliability ensured via sequence/ack on CAN where available; buffer strategy: small FIFO for commands to preserve ordering
interface_plan.performance_requirements: end-to-end latency <20ms, ordering preserved, delivery confirmation preferred

interface_plan.name: SteeringTorque_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R, periodic 20ms with overwrite of latest value; best-effort for non-critical assist changes, reliable for stall/limit signals; buffering: latest-value

interface_plan.name: CAN_Message_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: 原始CAN帧的S/R接口，用于CANGateway与组件间帧交换；异步事件驱动，按消息ID优先级转发；缓冲策略为按优先级多队列，错误处理为重发与错误计数上报
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 帧转发延时 <5ms, 支持多总线映射与ID转换

interface_plan.name: Control_Service_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: C/S 接口用于同步配置与请求发送服务（例如CANGateway的SendWithAck）；同步/异步支持，超时与重试策略明确，超时一般 <100ms
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 控制服务高可靠，超时与错误返回必报，支持同期调用与结果点

interface_plan.name: HealthMonitor_IF
interface_plan.communication_pattern: S/R 用于发布健康与安全状态，周期或事件触发（周期10ms），缓冲为重复上报直到确认接收策略，关键告警采用高优先级通道
interface_plan.performance_requirements: 紧急告警在50ms内传播，可靠送达机制与多次重发
interface_plan.direct_paths: SafetyMonitor -> 所有控制器及诊断收集端

connection_topology.component_connections: WheelSpeedProcessor publishes WheelSpeed_IF consumed by ABSController, ESPController, SafetyMonitor. ABSController and EPSController publish actuator commands (BrakeCommand_IF, SteeringTorque_IF) which are routed through CANGateway to actuator ECUs. CANGateway connects to multiple CAN buses and provides Control_Service_IF to other controllers for synchronous send/route config. SafetyMonitor subscribes to WheelSpeed_IF, Health inputs and can invoke Control_Service_IF on CANGateway to send safety commands.
connection_topology.data_flow_paths: Sensor -> WheelSpeedProcessor (CAN_Message_IF) -> WheelSpeed_IF -> ABS/EPS/ESP/SafetyMonitor. ABSController -> BrakeCommand_IF -> CANGateway -> BrakeActuator. EPSController -> SteeringTorque_IF -> CANGateway -> SteeringActuator. ESPController -> ESP_Command (S/R) -> ABSController/EPSController. SafetyMonitor -> HealthMonitor_IF -> all controllers.
connection_topology.control_flow_paths: CANGateway provides synchronous service endpoints (Control_Service_IF) used by ABS/EPS/SafetyMonitor for confirmed sends; ABS/EPS control loops run locally at 5ms/20ms respectively; ESPController may trigger immediate interventions to ABS/EPS via S/R or event notifications; SafetyMonitor can issue global degrade/stop commands via Control_Service_IF.

architecture_rationale.design_decisions: 采用发布/订阅(S/R)分离传感器数据与控制命令，CANGateway作为消息汇聚与跨总线路由实体，减少跨组件直接依赖，便于总线管理与安全审计。关键控制器为应用SWC，各自包含实时runnable以满足不同周期需求。SafetyMonitor作为独立ASIL-D实体以保证安全隔离与独立检测能力。
architecture_rationale.tradeoff_analysis: 集中式路由(CANGateway)简化网络管理和消息映射但增加单点转发延迟；分布式直接通信可降低延时但降低可控性与安全审计能力。选择S/R用于高频传感器数据以保持低耦合，选择C/S用于需要确认的发送或配置操作以确保可靠性。为满足性能与安全，部分高频控制保留本地周期runnable。
architecture_rationale.alternative_considerations: 可选将WheelSpeedProcessor分布到多个ECU以靠近传感器减少总线负载；或者将CANGateway功能拆分到多个网关ECU以降低单点故障风险；在更高性能需求下引入时间触发通信或CAN-FD。
architecture_rationale.risk_assessment: 主要风险包括总线拥塞与优先级反转、CANGateway单点故障、SafetyMonitor误报或延迟响应。缓解措施：关键消息设置高优先级与带宽保障；CANGateway实现冗余路径或降级策略；SafetyMonitor 使用独立时钟与硬件隔离并加固超时/重试策略。
